mechanisms.name: inline reference marker filter
mechanisms.rule: a parenthesised token preceded within 40 chars by a reference lead-in (clause(s), paragraph(s), section(s), subsection(s), item(s), through, spelled numerals) or followed within 16 chars by a reference trailer (through, above, below, hereof, thereof, of this/the/such Section|clause|...) is not a structural label; reference status propagates along ', / and / or / through' chains

mechanisms.name: hanging-paragraph pop
mechanisms.rule: when a paragraph break followed by prose separates the previous label from a start-of-new-list label, the innermost open list is closed before the new list opens, so a new label family after a closed list does not nest under the last item

mechanisms.name: nearest same-family list wins for mid-line continuation
mechanisms.rule: a continuation marker that appears mid-line inside an inline enumeration (bare comma or conjunction, not ';' or ':') does not resume a far-outer list when a nearer open list of the same marker family exists

mechanisms.name: comma exclusion limited to horizontal whitespace
mechanisms.rule: MARKER_OCCURRENCE lookbehind (?<!,[ \t]) so a line-start label after ',\n' is still a label
